speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our examination, please tell me: what were the specific symptoms or concerns that brought you here for your newborn today?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that background. Since the mother had no prenatal care, I need to know: have you noticed any yellowing of the skin or eyes since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The combination of a continuous murmur (patent ductus arteriosus), blueberry muffin rash (petechiae), and congenital cataracts with hearing loss is pathognomonic for this condition.
